text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: Frames 16.0 to 16.8 s. The white car, tilted, exits at the left edge by 16.4 s carrying foam. From 16.6 s the creek and banks are empty and the caption is gone. The last two frames hold on empty water for a few tenths of a second before the cut to the next scene at 17.24 s.
